body:
okay here is the TR from the Outpost 2000 sat. tournament.  THere were 20 people who played that day, I was playing TIGIHis deadbody (will post after this report), and BHBM pip-pip-cheerio drains (BHBM with star destroyers and big drains)



Game 1 my LS vs. Justin Alfs and his gay as Elton John TDIGWATT navy trooper odds.



	Okay as is going to be the theme of all my LS games this game ended in 1 battle, he had Choke Vader and Palpy holding Luke at the back door. I deploy Han and Leia epp style, plus Chewie Protector, he tries to Force Zap chewie, I sense got it.  But Nick the TD rules that Palpy still loses his immmunity and is def value -2 since that is a seperate sentence at the start of the lost text.  I then deploy Obi-w/stick.  Battle, chop Vader, Satm/BP him away, shoot palpy, draw Battle destiny 5,5,1 he draws 2 from IHYN and draws about 5 total.  He loses palpy and about 22 more.  He then spreads out on CC and sets up dark deal, qui-gon pay a visit to a lone trooper, and kill him for some force.  THe game ended with a drain race, and I won thatnks to the sizeable head start.  FW by 15



On a side note we played a rematch and Justin won by  about 15 oh well it was the only game his DS would win all day:).



Game 2 my DS vs. Chris who later traded me an emperor for a AA quigon, and his HB  OMDH

	Okay about 10 mins into this game he said "you won" I said what lets play it out.  I drained him in space, he really did nothing, he caused some early damage with suicide luke and my objective did some damage, but I really didn’t know what he was trying until I Saw OMDH hit the lost pile and no Alderaan on table.  It turns out that he accidentally put his only alderaan under his obbjective, so he really had no chance of winning.  I think I would have done okay anyway, but this win really didn’t feel good.  FW by about 20



Game 3 my LS vs. Rich jeffery and his Court of the evil podracer.

	Okay this game ended when I SATMed Ephant Mon and beat Jabba for 29 overflow with my epp hit squad.  I lost the podrace, but that only served to lower my diff since he hadn’t saved force so there was no retrieval for him (why doesn’t everyone play with Aim High) sorry this was so short, but this game was a 29 overflow beatdown on about turn 5 and then drain out.  FW by about 20.



Game 4 my DS vs. Jeff Casper (the friendly ghost:) and his EBO Y-wings.



	Okay before this game I head Kohmann tell jeff that he stood a good chance, now I had never played Jeff, but Kohmann has played me enough to know that I am always tough to play, and it bugged me to hear him marginalize me like that (you lost your props there kohmann, especially since I am still way above 500 against you).  This game was a race for me to keep control of 2 systems to keep Imperial decree running, while still getting my drains in and giving him some battle damage.  Unfournately it was marred by a disagreement where I said something unnecessarily hurtful when Jeff wanted to play the game with no takebacks and I wanted to take back moving a ship that ultimatly wouldn’t have mattered much.   Otherwise it was a very strategic and fun game with Battle plan and Imperial decree pulling out a tight win for me.  FW by 5



	Okay I just want to say I’m sorry again to Jeff, I didn"t mean tto hurt your feelings and I hope we are okay with each other.



Game 5 my DS vs. Rob Jeffery and his TIGIH



	Okay I knew that this was a bad matchup, but I played crappy by forgetting to pull systems, and dropping star destroyers there, but Rob still beat me very badly, he just kept throwing scouts at me at the Endor DB and I couldn’t stop him. FL by 23



Game 6 my LS vs. Rob and his copy of Richs Court podracing.



	This game ended about the same way, I just barely lost the podrace, but since he didn’t have enough to retrieve it just made me lose 11, then I jumped Mighty Jabba wiht EPP hand and Leia, plus a nabruned over Obi and Luke, and he lost about 30 overflow.  Game..

	FW by 23



Okay so I finished 5-1 with a terribly crappy diff but since I was the only 5-1 without a timed win I won the tourney and got a Foil Twi’lek.  Soryr the LS descriptions are so short, but when you cause 20-30 overflow in a game in one battle there really isn’t anything else that the DS can do.



Props and Slops



Props:

Jeff Casper for a good game

Everyone else for good games

Kohmann for beating Jim and giving me the win

Grace, Justin, Graham and Raveling for all going 3-3 WTF happened to you guys I hope you do better at GenCon

Nick for a good Tourney



Slops:

Me for how I acted during the game with Jeff (sorry man)

my DS for pretty much sucking (although it did go 2-1)



Thats all folks

summary: Garrett Larson won a 20-player Saturday tournament at Outpost 2000 on 28 July 2001, going 5–1 with There Is Good In Him and Bring Him Before Me and losing only to Rob Jeffery.
notes: Event: 'the Outpost 2000 sat. tournament', 20 players, TD Nick; date from the title (7-28-01, a Saturday). The report names no city or state. The List places Outpost 2000 and Beyond in Minneapolis (May 2001 Minneapolis tournament (26 May)), but a city inferred from other events is not used, so it is named by state: 'July 2001 Minnesota tournament' (the author and his opponents are Minnesota players; no other July 2001 Minnesota event on the List).
Win: 'since I was the only 5-1 without a timed win I won the tourney and got a Foil Twi'lek'. No tournament points given; margins for games 2 and 3 are 'about 20'.
Format Premiere - Tatooine (July 2001, podracing in play, no Coruscant cards).
Light deck page: the report says 'TIGIHis deadbody (will post after this report)'; [[Garrett Larson TIGIHis deadbody]] was posted 30 July 2001, the same day, so deck_page is set.

'Jeff Casper (the friendly ghost)' mapped to the existing [[Jeff Kasper]] page (Minnesota player; Larson and Kasper both played Jim Li's St. Cloud event a week earlier, d2686). Justin Alfs and Rich Jeffery linked to existing pages. Rob Jeffery (full name in game 5) has no page. Chris (game 2) is first name only.
Objectives: Alfs's TDIGWATT, Chris's 'HB OMDH' as Hidden Base, both Court podracing decks as Court Of The Vile Gangster, Rob's TIGIH. Kasper's 'EBO Y-wings' names no objective.
Props say Grace, Justin, Graham and Raveling 'all going 3-3' — records, not placings; not recorded. 'Kohmann for beating Jim and giving me the win' (no full names).

Content check: game 1 calls Alfs's deck 'gay as Elton John'. Treated like earlier unheld reports that call decks 'gay' (e.g. d1587, d504 'gay Ricki Martin'): a jab at a deck, not a sexual claim or degrading insult aimed at the player, so not held. The author also apologises in the report to Jeff Kasper for 'something unnecessarily hurtful' said during their game (not quoted).
